text_block_list.text: While having a meeting with Tosen Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...My roots look terrible.
They grew out way too much. Total buzzkill.
choice_data_list: Aren't you going to get new nails?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I ain't got time for that.
It's just race, race, race non-stop.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I seriously can't slack off on my toenails...
As for my hands, well... better than bare nails, I guess.

That's unusual for someone so meticulous about her nails.
She must be terribly fatigued.
It might be best to review her race schedule.
